title: AIE-active fluorescent probes as ‘turn-off’ sensors for the selective detection of Cr6+ and Fe3+ ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35460-35467
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05760D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiefa Shen, Jialing Mao, Xinlan Ding, Chengze Wu, Shenghu Yan, Sai Zhang, Yue Zhang
Two novel AIE probes were synthesized via Suzuki coupling. They serve as sensitive ‘turn-off’ fluorescent sensors for the selective detection of Cr6+ and Fe3+ ions, showing great potential for environmental monitoring.
